attempts.summary: Configured a 1 GiB file-backed LUKS2 encrypted XFS volume mounted at /srv/secure. It unlocks and mounts automatically through systemd using /etc/crypttab and /etc/fstab. The RHEL 10.0 release and kernel remain unchanged, SELinux remains enforcing, SSH remains available, and no failed units remain. Reboot persistence was verified with a changed boot identity and preserved data checksum.
